# Navimower Map Card 0.3.1-beta3

0.3.1-beta3 makes the Notifications view substantially more compact and gives the growing card header more room, while retaining the field-tested Navimower 0.4.2-beta2 read actions.

## Compact Notifications

- Notification content is collapsed by default. Each retained item initially shows only its timestamp row and title.
- Unread items keep the orange **Mark as read** action at the end of the timestamp row.
- Clicking a notification title expands/collapses its body. If the item is unread, the same click also calls `navimower.mark_notification_read` with its vendor `message_id`.
- Clicking **Mark as read** itself does not expand the body.
- **Mark all as read** remains centered in the dialog header whenever any retained notification is unread.
- The previous unread dot is hidden in the compact layout; unread state is conveyed by the read action and the orange Notifications header state.
- The card still never changes `read` optimistically and never talks to the Navimow private cloud directly. The refreshed `Latest notification` sensor remains authoritative.

## Two-row card header

- The configured card title now occupies its own row.
- **History**, **Notifications** + bell, and **Schedule** share a separate action row underneath and may wrap on narrow cards instead of competing with a long mower title.
- Added `show_title`, default `true`, so the title row can be hidden entirely.

## Visual editor cleanup

- Reworked the General section into two balanced columns: **Mower entity** with Auto-detect below it, and **Title** with Show title below it.
- Added a dedicated external **Title** caption above the title text input instead of relying on the text field's floating label.
- The existing `trail_length` setting remains functional because it caps the browser-side active/fallback live trail. It is now labelled **Live trail point cap** with helper text clarifying that completed mowed-area history is unaffected.
- Existing notification settings remain unchanged: `notification_page_size` defaults to 3 with range 1–5, and `notification_mark_read_on_open` defaults to false.

## Compatibility

- Navimower integration **0.4.2-beta2 or later** remains required for notification read actions.
- Existing cards without `show_title` keep their title visible.
- Existing YAML using `trail_length` continues to work unchanged.

## Cache-safe beta asset

HACS loads `navimower-map-card-0.3.1-b3.js`. Beta1 and beta2 retain their own `-b1.js` and `-b2.js` loader URLs, while stable 0.3.1 remains reserved for `navimower-map-card-0.3.1.js`.
